units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 16:2">Kel. XVI, 2</cite> <he>משיחסום וִיקַנֵּב</he> when he has peeled them (the wicker baskets) and trimmed them (pinched off the projecting pricks); <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 16:3">ib. 3</cite>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 7:11">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. VII, 11</cite> (not <he>וינקב</he>); <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 7:12">12</cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 4:4:4">Y. Pes. IV, 31ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>מְקַנֵּב</he> he may clean (vegetable); a. e.—Part. pass. <he>מְקוּנָּב</he>. Tosef. Kel. l. c. <he>חתוכין ומְקוּנָּבִין</he> cut and cleansed.
